d: Are you a commercial lawyer who wants to be the first legal hire in a technology business expanding across the GCC?

A fast growing AI powered smart mobility company based in Dubai has gone from a handful of pilot sites to hundreds of live locations across the UAE in under two years, backed by major real estate and infrastructure partnerships and genuine, working AI technology.

Contracts with developers, malls, hospitals, hotels, airports and government entities are being signed at pace, and the company is now moving into Qatar and Saudi Arabia. It needs its own in house legal counsel to protect that growth.
The first dedicated legal hire, with the standard contractual positions, templates and playbooks yours to write
Reporting into the CEO and CFO, working directly with senior leadership on live commercial deals
Real involvement in GCC expansion, new entities, joint ventures and strategic partnerships
Interesting technology work across AI, ANPR, payment systems and platform integrations
r: Reviewing, drafting and negotiating commercial agreements with customers, suppliers, landlords, developers and government entities
Negotiating revenue share, minimum guarantee and management fee structures, and the SLAs, liability, indemnity and termination provisions that sit around them
Handling technology agreements covering AI and ANPR systems, hardware, software, cloud platforms, integrations and payments, and protecting the company's intellectual property
Supporting expansion into Qatar, Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets, advising on local requirements and coordinating external counsel
Building the legal infrastructure from scratch, including standard positions, negotiation playbooks, templates and a central contract repository
Tracking contractual obligations, renewals, notices and termination dates, and flagging recurring risk to the business
6 to 10 years post-qualification experience (Flexible for the right experience)
Strong UAE and GCC commercial legal experience
A real commercial contract negotiation background, not purely advisory work
In house experience in technology, infrastructure, mobility, SaaS or facilities management is a bonus
Comfortable translating legal risk into practical commercial advice for executives
Based in Dubai and this is an onsite role
Don't worry if your CV isn't up to date. Share your LinkedIn profile and we'll take it from there. You can also reach me directly if you'd like to find out more.

d: The Marketing Executive is accountable for developing and implementing marketing campaigns with the aim of promoting company products and services. S/He handles various responsibilities ranging from creative, analytical, digital, commercial and administrative, all aligned towards the achievement of the overall marketing strategy.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or Advertising.
At least 3 years of relevant experience.
r: Participate in the development of the marketing strategy based on market insights and data analytics retrieved from different channels at hand
Participate in the creation and development of marketing campaigns and follow through the implementation with concerned parties both internally and externally
Organize and oversee campaigns and promotional events on social media using different channels and targeting various audiences
Conduct market research and analysis to evaluate trends, brand awareness and competition using different tools including but not limited to focus groups, call backs, surveys etc.
Gather and analyze data that helps identify and define future campaigns and activities for targeted audiences
Produce creative written and multimedia contents to be used on different digital and online platforms increasing engagement
Write, edit and proofread creative contents for diverse marketing productions (brochures, website, press releases, materials, etc.)
Maintain the company website and update all information at all times
Develop and maintain positive relationships with key external partners including media, advertising companies, agencies etc.
Follow up and monitor the progress of campaigns and events using various metrics and submit reports accordingly
Organize events and exhibitions in coordination with internal and external parties
Coordinate with the sales team and develop targeted marketing campaigns and activities that meet sales strategies.

d: The job holder shall be responsible to reviews the organizations financial statements, documents, and accounting entries and gather and review information from financial reporting systems, account balances, cash flow statements, income statements, balance sheets etc to present all financial data in an accurate, fair manner. Also comparing present and past statistics to improve the business financially.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Business Administration with Finance Majors/ or Accounting will be considered.
Minimum of 10 years of experience in related field.
r: Comply with MOPH’s set of policies, procedures, management and regulatory requirements, and International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS).
Ensure that all financial and accounting transactions are recorded in compliance with MOPH’s accounting procedures and IPSAS.
Develop and implement accounting system, procedures, and internal controls.
Study the statements/documents in detail prior to commencing the reviewing process.
Plan financial/accounting reviews of organization from start to finish.
Collect, prepare, and organize physical and digital documentation for reviewing processes.
Identify key areas and issues for further investigation and analysis.
Verify and evaluate figures, accounts, and statements with other accountant team members.
Compile and present findings in written and verbal forms to senior members of the team.
Recommend on subsequent actions and processes to be undertaken for enhancing the practices and provide solutions to accounting issues as they arise
Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related units to achieve the Department’s goals/objectives.
Identify areas for professional development of self and all direct reports, and act to enhance professional development of self and others.
Ensure high standards of confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
Perform other duties as requested to meet the ongoing organizational needs.

d: Mahally is Saudi Arabia’s home for local commerce. We bring thousands of Saudi stores — across beauty, fashion, home, food, gifting, electronics, and more — into one marketplace and one app, making it easier for customers to discover and buy from local brands.
We’re more than a catalogue. Mahally is a demand engine for Saudi merchants — helping great products get discovered and connecting shoppers with local businesses they may not have found otherwise.
We’re looking for an SEO Manager to own Mahally’s organic search strategy end-to-end, covering technical SEO, content and organic growth, and AI-driven discovery (GEO/AEO).
This is not a keyword-reporting role.

Mahally is a large, dynamic marketplace with millions of URLs, constantly changing stores and products, and significant opportunities to improve how search engines crawl, index, understand, and rank our content.

You’ll lead the work to strengthen our technical SEO foundation, improve indexation and discoverability, build scalable organic landing-page strategies, and create sustainable organic growth that isn’t dependent on individual merchants or products.
You’ll also help shape how Mahally appears across emerging AI and answer engines, including ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google’s AI-powered search experiences.
Working closely with Engineering, Product, Content, and Merchant teams, you’ll turn SEO opportunities into clear priorities and measurable business impact.
Success will be measured not only by rankings and visibility, but by qualified organic traffic, orders, and GMV.
q: 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience , with proven experience managing SEO for a large-scale e-commerce platform, marketplace, classifieds site, or other high-volume website .
Strong technical SEO expertise , with hands-on experience diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalisation, and site architecture .

Proven experience managing SEO for websites with 100K+ indexable URLs/pages , including solving large-scale challenges such as index bloat, faceted navigation, duplicate or thin content, and crawl-budget optimisation .
Advanced hands-on experience with Google Search Console, GA4, SEO crawling tools such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb, and SEO platforms such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent tools .
Practical experience implementing, auditing, and optimising structured data/schema markup , particularly for e-commerce, including Product, Offer, Breadcrumb, Organization, or similar schemas.
Professional proficiency in both Arabic and English , with the ability to conduct Arabic keyword and search-intent research and assess the quality and relevance of Arabic SEO content.

Strong analytical and commercial mindset , with the ability to quantify SEO opportunities, prioritise initiatives based on potential impact, and measure results across organic traffic, conversions, and business outcomes.
Proven experience partnering directly with Engineering and Product teams to translate SEO findings into clear technical requirements and successfully deliver SEO improvements at scale.
Experience with GEO/AEO and AI-powered search discovery .
SQL, Python, or scripting experience for log analysis, bulk SEO audits, or automated monitoring.
Experience with multilingual SEO, including hreflang and Arabic/English content strategies.
Experience with App Store Optimization (ASO) or web-to-app discovery.
Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the GCC , with an understanding of local search and consumer behaviour.
Digital PR, authority-building, or regional link-acquisition experience.
r: Own technical SEO for a marketplace at scale: crawl budget, indexation, canonicalisation, pagination, faceted navigation, internal linking, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals, and JS rendering.
Diagnose and resolve index bloat — decide which page types deserve to be indexed at all, and enforce it through robots directives, canonical strategy, and sitemap hygiene.
Solve for churn: define what happens to a store or product URL when it disappears, so we stop leaking equity every time a merchant leaves.
Partner with Engineering on an SEO backlog that actually ships — with clear specs, acceptance criteria, and measured impact after release.
Design and grow durable page types — category, collection, brand, city, intent, and comparison pages — that don't depend on any single merchant staying.
Own the content roadmap for organic: Arabic-first keyword and intent research, briefs, publishing cadence, and refresh cycles.
Optimise store and product templates: titles, meta, headings, structured data, on-page copy, and merchandising signals.
Build internal linking as a system, not a one-off project.
Define and execute Mahally's strategy for generative and answer engines: crawler access policy, structured data, entity clarity, citable content, and brand presence in AI answers.
Make deliberate decisions about which AI crawlers we allow and why — and be able to defend the trade-off between control and visibility.
Track and report where Mahally appears in AI answers for commercial Saudi queries, and close the gaps.
Own Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and log-file analysis. Build reporting that ties organic to sessions, orders, and GMV — not just impressions.
Set up rank, indexation, and coverage monitoring with alerts, so we catch a drop in days rather than a quarter.
Run structured tests on page templates and title/meta patterns and report the causal read where you can get one.
Brief and influence Engineering, Product, and Content without owning their roadmaps.
Guide merchants on the content and imagery that make their pages rank and convert.
Present organic performance, risks, and opportunities to leadership with a clear point of view and a clear ask.

You’ll help Mahally build an organic acquisition engine that scales with the marketplace — improving how efficiently our pages are crawled and indexed, increasing qualified organic discovery, creating durable search surfaces, and strengthening Mahally’s presence across both traditional and AI-powered search.
Ultimately, your work will translate organic visibility into more customers, more orders, and more growth for Saudi merchants.

q: As a Techno-Functional Salesforce Consultant, you'll be the bridge between our clients' business needs and the Salesforce solutions that meet them. You'll work closely with client stakeholders and our delivery teams to shape requirements, configure and build the solution, and step in to fix things when they don't work as they should. It's a role for someone who is as comfortable leading a workshop as they are reading code.
A clear communicator who can explain technical ideas to business people, and business needs to technical teams.
Curious about how businesses work, and quick to understand what a client is really trying to achieve.
A hands-on problem solver who enjoys getting to the root of an issue and fixing it properly.
Confident in front of clients, and able to build trust with stakeholders at different levels.
Organised and dependable, able to balance several priorities without losing quality.
A team player who shares what you know and is open to learning from others.
5 to 7 years of experience in the Salesforce ecosystem.
Hands-on experience with at least three of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and Marketing Cloud.
Strong functional experience gathering requirements and designing Salesforce solutions for real business processes.
Hands-on Salesforce configuration skills, including data model, security, and declarative automation.
The ability to write and debug code in Apex and Lightning Web Components, and to build and support integrations with other systems.
Salesforce Administrator and Platform Developer I certifications.
Experience delivering Salesforce projects for clients from discovery through to go-live, with excellent written and spoken communication skills.
r: Work with client stakeholders to understand their business processes, goals and pain points.
Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories and Salesforce solution designs.
Configure Salesforce to deliver those requirements, from data model and security to automation.
Write and maintain code and integrations where configuration isn't enough, and troubleshoot and fix issues in existing solutions.
Run workshops, demos and playbacks that help clients understand and adopt what we build.
Support testing, deployment and go-live, and help clients make the most of Salesforce afterwards.
Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to how our Salesforce practice grows.
x: Comprehensive medical insurance plan for employee and spouse and children
Visa for employee and spouse and children
Annual return flight to home country for self
Flexible office times and working from home twice per week
Remote working from a place of your choice for 2 weeks a year
Free snacks and drinks in the office

q: At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Full Time Technology Analyst Program is where forward-thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact on the most global financial institution!

Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.
We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The 2-year Analyst Program starts in July and begins with a robust training program. Here at Citi, rotational programs are intended to help you build a broad skillset and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to more than one team. Our rotational program will help you discover the best fit for your skills and long-term career goals at Citi.
Your time here will look like this...

You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.
While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:
Back-End Development: Java, Python, Spring Framework
Front-End Development: Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)

Generative AI & AI Agents : GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
Data Analytics: Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:
Global Exposure: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.

Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.

Real Impact: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.
To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria
Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.
A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.
Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.
Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.
Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.
Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.
Work Authorization: Authorized to work in Bahrain without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.
Who we think will be a great fit...

A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.
This program is ideal for those who
Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.
Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.
